solver_notes: Native Rust scheduler regression model for the declared Tokio worker starvation issue, not a claim of an upstream Tokio patch. The legacy worker repeatedly polls a nested future that returns Pending without yielding, so its nonempty local queue permanently starves the global queue. The fixed worker decrements a 128-poll cooperative budget and forces global-queue fallback every 64 ticks even while local work remains; the global task completes exactly at tick 64. Executed on physical aarch64 with rustc 1.98.1. The first fixed harness ran to the 256-tick bound instead of stopping after global completion; that discarded failure was corrected by breaking on completion before the final passing runs. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
